name: Observed values for one metric attribute key, most frequent first
description: Observed values for one metric attribute key, most frequent first Observed values for one metric attribute key, most frequent first. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/metrics/attribute_values/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/metrics/attribute_values/
Observed values for one metric attribute key, most frequent first. Backs the filter bar's value autocomplete.
Required: key (query) — Attribute key to list values for (e.g. 'env'). 'service_name'/'service.name' list service names.; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: dateFrom (query) — Lower bound (inclusive) of the window values are suggested from. ISO 8601. Defaults to 7 days ago.; dateTo (query) — Upper bound (exclusive) of the window. ISO 8601. Defaults to now.; limit (query) — Max number of values to return. Defaults to 100; maximum 1000.; value (query) — Substring filter (case-insensitive) applied to values. Named 'value' to match the property-values autocomplete convention.

name: Attribute keys ordered by distinct series count, from highest to lowest
description: Attribute keys ordered by distinct series count, from highest to lowest Attribute keys ordered by distinct series count, from highest to lowest. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/metrics/attributes/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/metrics/attributes/
Attribute keys ordered by distinct series count, from highest to lowest. `metricName` limits choices to one metric.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: dateFrom (query) — Lower bound (inclusive) of the window keys are suggested from. ISO 8601. Defaults to 7 days ago.; dateTo (query) — Upper bound (exclusive) of the window. ISO 8601. Defaults to now.; limit (query) — Max number of keys to return. Defaults to 100; maximum 1000.; metricName (query) — Exact metric name to limit attribute keys to. Omit to list keys across all metrics.; search (query) — Substring filter (case-insensitive) applied to attribute keys.

context:

Distinct metric names for the viewer picker, without sparklines or caching.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: limit (query) — Max number of names to return. Defaults to 100; maximum 1000.; service (query) — Comma-separated services to narrow the list to, e.g. `service=web,worker`. A service name containing a comma cannot be selected.; value (query) — Substring filter (case-insensitive) applied to metric names.
